title: Add fishing from the beaches as year-round food
body:
- New tech Fishing (after Gathering); SIM_VERSION 2 marks shore tiles and stocks 240 fish
- Idle adults fish from beach sand: 3-6 food per 4h trip, all year incl. winter
- Fish regrow 5/day (2/day in winter); live world catches ~1700 food/yr at 13 people
- Fishers show in teal with a rod and bobbing line; "+n" catches pop in teal
- Watch: winter shore activity, and whether spring stores rise in the early years

title: Add granaries; grain left in the open now rots
body:
- New tech Granaries (after Farming + Woodcutting); SIM_VERSION 3 tags old buildings as houses
- Each house keeps 150 food dry, each granary 2500; dry food spoils 0.05%/day, the rest 0.2%/day
- Villagers raise a granary (30 timber, 24h) when stores pass 85% of dry space, up to 1 per 12 people
- Long-run stores drop from ~900 days of food to ~150-300; panel shows granaries and grain rotting
- Watch: the first granary on Hais this spring, and whether births slow when stores dip below 250/person

title: Add daily weather: rain, storms, heatwaves, frost, snow
body:
- SIM_VERSION 4: each day's weather is a seasonal Markov chain (clear, rain, storm, heat, cold snap, snow), so bad days come in runs
- Rain speeds crop growth x1.25, heat slows it to x0.4, cold to x0.5; cold snaps double winter firewood and chill the frail; heat is hard on elders
- Storms keep everyone indoors, flatten 3% of tall fields per day and can tear off a roof (repaired as a building job)
- Visible: rain, snow, storm flashes, heat haze, tinted sky, snow on roofs, roofless houses, flattened fields; weather shown next to the date
- Watch: slower early growth (100-yr pop ~260 vs ~280), and woods lasting longer (forest ~450 tiles at Y100 vs ~210)

title: Add wolves and boars to the woods of the island
body:
- SIM_VERSION 5: a wolf pack dens in the deepest forest, boars lie up in cover near the fields (3 each, herd size follows forest cover)
- Wolves prowl the treeline from dusk to dawn (and on winter cold snaps); a lone adult away from the houses can be bitten (12 days laid up) or killed; a helper nearby drives the wolf off. ~1 attack and ~0.1 deaths a year
- After an attack the village comes in at 16:00 and goes out at 07:00 for 45 days; boars root through growing grain near the woods on ~14 spring/summer nights a year
- Visible: grey wolves with glowing eyes at night, boars rooting in fields, torn-up field tiles, bandaged villagers, a Wilds row in the panel
- Watch: first bite and first raid in the chronicle; 100-yr pop ~217 vs ~259 before

title: Add hunting: boar and wolf hunts, meat and hides
body:
- New tech Hunting (SIM_VERSION 6); live world learns it on load, new worlds after the first boar raid or wolf attack
- Every 6 days a pair sets out at dawn for the boar lair, or the wolf den in winter and after an attack; trip must fit before dusk
- Success 50% boar / 35% wolf (about half alone); 8-10% chance the beast turns, rarely fatal; herds never hunted below 2
- Kills are carried home on a shoulder (+45 meat boar, +12 wolf); hides dry on a rack by the hearth, cut winter firewood up to 30%, wear out yearly
- Visible: red hunters with spears, carcass on the way home, hide rack, Hunt row in panel; watch for the first boar taken on Hais this spring

title: Speed up the simulation about 4x with identical results
body:
- Cache the best field site until a tile changes; keep a daily list of tall trees near the hearth
- Find the nearest fishing spot by 8x8 map blocks; index houses by id; per-hour lists of ripe/fallow fields and unfinished buildings
- Same world, same choices: fingerprints match the old code for 100 years on seed 4242 and 15 years on the live world
- Seed 4242: 2773 -> 631 ms per year on average, ~1.5 s at 331 people (was ~8 s); browsers catch up faster on load
- Watch: tiles must now change through setTile() in the step path, or the field-site cache goes stale

title: Add wattle fences to keep boars out of the fields
body:
- New tech Fences (SIM_VERSION 7), learned after the 8th boar raid; the live world (2 raids so far) should learn it in early summer of Y1
- Idle workers fence fields within 2 tiles of the woods (3 timber, 3 h, not in winter); a fence turns a boar away for the night 85% of the time
- Fences wear out: 20% rot each new year, 2% per storm day blow down, and a boar that gets through breaks the fence, so mending never ends
- Raid nights drop from ~10 to ~3.5 a year; fences drawn as woven hazel edges with stakes around each fenced block; Fields row shows how many are fenced
- Watch: the first fence and the first night the boars are turned away in the chronicle

title: Add a midsummer festival with bonfire and ring dance
body:
- New custom Midsummer (SIM_VERSION 8, w.fest); the live world learns it on load, new worlds at 10 people
- On summer day 46 work stops at 16:00: everyone gathers at a big bonfire (up to 12 timber), feasts 2 food each if stores allow, and dances until 23:00; rain delays it up to 4 days, a storm until it clears
- At 21:00 each single woman has a 40% chance to pair up in the firelight; the year's festival is logged, the 1st and every 25th go in the chronicle
- Visible: tall flickering bonfire with rising sparks, villagers in rings turning around it with flower crowns, "midsummer fire" next to the date
- Watch: the first midsummer on Hais this summer (Y1, about 70 game days away)

title: Add click-to-follow: a life card for any islander
body:
- Click a villager to follow them: the camera glides to them and keeps them centred, with thin white brackets around them (dashed round their house while they sleep)
- A card shows name, age, what they are doing, parents, partner, children and housemates; click any name to follow that person instead
- The card also lists the last three log entries that mention them; if they die it says so and shows how
- Drag to look around (the card stays, "find" brings the camera back); click empty ground, press Esc or the cross to let go
- Render only: no change to the simulation, saved state or SIM_VERSION

title: Add fever outbreaks that spread through crowded houses
body:
- SIM_VERSION 9 (w.fever, p.sick, p.imm): a fever can take hold any day, most often in autumn and winter, more in crowded houses and bigger villages; castaways bring it ashore 15% of the time
- It spreads 10%/day per sick housemate plus a little across the village; 6-10 days in bed, then 4 years immune, so outbreaks burn out
- Sick islanders stop working and skip midsummer; infants and elders are most at risk (~3-4% of cases die, double when hungry or cold); 100-yr pop on seed 20261114 drops ~199 -> 151
- Visible: sick lie under a blanket in their doorway, pale green "fever" pops, "n sick" on the People row, "laid up with fever" on the follow card
- Watch: the first fever on Hais (likely within the first in-world year or two); outbreak ends are logged, and ones that take 3+ lives go in the chronicle

title: Add footpaths worn into the grass by daily walking
body:
- SIM_VERSION 10 (w.wear per tile): each hour's walk wears the grass it crosses; grass heals 1/day spring to autumn, not under snow
- Tiles worn to 24+ become bare-earth paths: walking on them is 4 tiles/h instead of 3, and the woods cannot regrow over them
- New tech Footpaths is noticed in-world once a track of 12+ path tiles leads 7+ tiles out from the hearth (the live world should see it within weeks of game time)
- Visible: scuffed grass, then ragged dirt tracks that join houses, beach and fields (grey slush in winter); Paths row in the panel
- Watch: trails to the beach and woodlots stay open as forest closes in; ~90-120 path tiles on test seeds
